# Configure EAS Build with eas.json

Learn how a project using EAS services is configured with eas.json.

## Signature / Usage

**eas.json** is the configuration file for EAS CLI and services, generated by `eas build:configure` and located next to **package.json**. EAS Build configuration lives under the `build` key. Default generated configuration:

```json
{
  "build": {
    "development": {
      "developmentClient": true,
      "distribution": "internal"
    },
    "preview": {
      "distribution": "internal"
    },
    "production": {}
  }
}
```

Run a profile (defaults to `production` if it exists when `--profile` is omitted):

```sh
eas build --profile <profile-name>
```

Schema:

```json
{
  "cli": {
    "version": "SEMVER_RANGE",
    "requireCommit": boolean,
    "appVersionSource": string,
    "promptToConfigurePushNotifications": boolean,
  },
  "build": {
    "BUILD_PROFILE_NAME_1": {
      ...COMMON_OPTIONS,
      "android": {
        ...COMMON_OPTIONS,
        ...ANDROID_OPTIONS
      },
      "ios": {
        ...COMMON_OPTIONS,
        ...IOS_OPTIONS
      }
    },
    "BUILD_PROFILE_NAME_2": {}
  }
}
```

Share configuration between profiles with `extends` (chain up to depth 5, no circular dependencies):

```json
{
  "build": {
    "production": { "node": "22.23.3" },
    "preview": { "extends": "production", "distribution": "internal" },
    "development": {
      "extends": "production",
      "developmentClient": true,
      "distribution": "internal"
    }
  }
}
```

Build tool versions, resource class and env:

```json
{
  "build": {
    "production": {
      "node": "22.23.3",
      "env": { "API_URL": "https://company.com/api" },
      "android": { "resourceClass": "medium" },
      "ios": { "resourceClass": "large" }
    }
  }
}
```

## Notes

- Build profile types: `development` (`developmentClient: true`, depends on `expo-dev-client`, never submitted to a store, defaults to `"distribution": "internal"`; iOS Simulator via `"ios": { "simulator": true }`), `preview` (no developer tools, installed by team; Android `.apk` recommended), `production` (submitted to stores; `.aab` default; `"buildType": "apk"` is the only way to install directly).
- Common properties can be set on the platform object or the profile root; platform-specific options take precedence.
- Tools that builds depend on include Node.js, npm, Yarn, Ruby, Bundler, CocoaPods, Fastlane, Xcode, and Android NDK. The base image controls defaults and non-settable versions (OS, Xcode).
- Resource class defaults to `medium`; `large` workers require a paid EAS plan.
- `env` values are used to evaluate **app.config.js** locally when you run `eas build`, and are set on the builder.
- Full property list: see eas-json.md (EAS Build section).
